name: Speed Boat Ideation
deliverable: Visual discovery of operational drag factors and mechanical engines

steps.text: Draw a boat labeled with the product or team, a destination, and an empty sea around it.
Ask people to add anchors for everything slowing progress and engines for everything speeding it up.
Have each person explain one anchor and one engine, placing the notes on the drawing.
Cluster the anchors and engines by theme, then rank which anchors should be cut first.
Turn the top anchors into commitments and name the engines the team must protect.

failure: Half-working looks like a decorated boat with dozens of anchors and no ranking: the drawing captures complaints but produces no decision about what to cut.
intervention: Ask the room to pick the two anchors that cost the most progress this month, and assign each one an owner before moving on.
provenance: Steps written for this deck from the method's public definition; the source has no protocol.

origin.note: A visual retrospective format; no origin given in the source.
